Otherwise it is just a scanner oops or Williams oops. / Super Oops engulf = Closes above prior high
action: Oops Reversal = the scanner definition (open < prior close, low < prior low, close > prior close); all 6 detector positives stay Yes. Teach three named versions with definitions and details: (1) Scanner Oops = the main definition above; (2) Williams Oops = opens below the prior LOW and rallies back above it (AAPL 2022-07-13 si_38dec06c4c4a is a Williams Oops but not a Scanner Oops; AAPL 2022-08-09, NVDA 2022-07-05, META 2022-07-13 are both); (3) Super Oops Reversal = any Oops version that fully engulfs the previous day = trades under the prior low AND closes above the prior HIGH (MSFT 2022-07-14 si_944aefc0e9c0, GOOGL 2022-07-05 si_74458acd0081).
